exposure: identified risk factors/features associated with preterm birth
cohort: The study included 2,567,040 mother-infant pairs from the 2022 cohort and 2,688,568 mother-infant pairs from the 2018 cohort using National Vital Statistics System (NVSS) birth data.
finding: A reliable preterm birth prediction nomogram, based on nine common risk factors identified by machine learning, was developed and externally validated with high accuracy (AUC >0.7).
